verdict.rationale: Insomnia is a desktop API client and design/testing tool. Proxying and governing live LLM/MCP traffic with token limits, prompt guards and provider routing is a runtime gateway function. Kong offers that through separate products (Kong AI Gateway, Konnect), not through Insomnia. Insomnia's MCP evidence is client-side only: it connects to and invokes MCP servers. Nothing in the pack shows Insomnia itself proxying or governing traffic, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can proxy and govern LLM/MCP traffic (token limits, prompt guards, provider routing) through the platform
